### KAS Fleet Health Dashboard

Fleet-wide view of kube-apiserver health across all HCP clusters: **error rates** and **traffic**.

Uses pre-computed recording rules (`kas:apiserver_request_*`). Error rate = 5xx responses / total requests.

**Related dashboards**: [KAS Availability SLO](/d/fezhc0hbfefb4f/kas-api-slo) · [KAS Golden Signals](/d/kas-golden-signals/kas-golden-signals) (per-cluster drill-in)

targets.expr: count(kas:apiserver_request_5xx:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"} / clamp_min(kas:apiserver_request_total:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"}, 1e-10) * 100 < 0.01) or vector(0)

count((kas:apiserver_request_5xx:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"} / clamp_min(kas:apiserver_request_total:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"}, 1e-10) * 100 >= 0.01) and (kas:apiserver_request_5xx:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"} / clamp_min(kas:apiserver_request_total:rate_avg_30d{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"}, 1e-10) * 100 < 0.1)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Average number of requests currently being processed by the kube-apiserver (5-minute average), broken down by request kind (mutating vs read-only). High values approaching the max-inflight limit indicate the API server is close to capacity.

targets.expr: sum by (request_kind) (kas:apiserver_inflight_requests:avg_5m{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: In-Flight Requests (Fleet Total)

panels.description: Rate at which the kube-apiserver forcibly terminates requests because max-inflight limits are exceeded. Non-zero values mean the API server is rejecting customer traffic — this is a customer-visible outage signal.

targets.expr: sum(kas:apiserver_request_terminations:rate5m{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Request Terminations (Fleet Total)

panels.description: Top 10 clusters by average in-flight request count. High values indicate clusters whose API servers are close to capacity.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, cluster, region) (kas:apiserver_inflight_requests:avg_5m{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Top 10 Clusters by In-Flight Saturation

panels.description: Clusters where the API server is forcibly terminating requests. Any entry here means customer traffic is being dropped on that cluster.

targets.expr: topk(10, kas:apiserver_request_terminations:rate5m{region=~"$region", cluster=~"$cluster"} > 0)

panels.title: Clusters with Non-Zero Terminations

options.content:
### Latency Panels — Pending

Fleet-wide latency distribution panels require HCP-level preprocessing recording rules.

The underlying histogram (`apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds`) was removed from the metrics allowlist ([PR #7244](https://github.com/Azure/ARO-HCP/pull/7244)) due to ~103k series with no alert consumer. The proposed path forward is preprocessing — running recording rules inside each cluster's Prometheus to compute the latency SLO ratio locally, shipping only the result.

This requires changes to the HyperShift operator's monitoring configuration. A separate Jira tracks this work.
